alternatives.option: adding updated_at to the decision store

context: Wrote the implementation plan for the dashboard scale redesign (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-09-dashboard-scale-redesign.md): 17 tasks across 5 phases — server query layer + 5k fixture, index store + virtualized lists, canvas density timeline, graph drill-down explorer, health/scope/routing/cleanup.
rationale: chose this over adding updated_at to the decision store because it needs zero store changes and the refetch cost (~200KB gzipped) is acceptable at the 5k envelope.
